points.description: Method (M): Chooses a valid approach for complex arithmetic (rectangular addition for denominator, correct polar rules for multiplication/division).
points.partial_credit: Deduction of 2 marks for M1 or M2 errors.

levels.says: One of the two method criteria (M1 or M2) is violated.

points.description: Equation/Setup (E): Correct setup of relations (denominator sum, polar multiplication/division rules).
points.partial_credit: Deduction of 2 marks for E1 or E2 errors.

levels.says: One of the two setup criteria (E1 or E2) is violated.

points.description: Calculation (C): Correct arithmetic, magnitude/angle operations, and conversions.
points.partial_credit: Deduction of 3 marks for each error (C1, C2, C3, or C4).

points.description: Units/Format (U): Final polar form expressed correctly with units.
points.partial_credit: Deduction of 1 mark for U1 or U2 errors.

levels.says: One unit/format error (U1 or U2) is present.

points.description: Not Complete (NC): Work contains all essential elements and final polar form.
points.partial_credit: Deduction of 3 marks for each error (NC1, NC2, or NC3).

levels.says: One completion error (NC1, NC2, or NC3) is present.

points.description: Base marks for starting the problem correctly.

rubric.notes: The student starts with 100 marks. Deductions are applied for each specific error identified in the rubric categories (M, E, C, U, NC). If a student makes no errors, they retain the full 100 marks.
